name: Leonard Miller
source:
MC's father. Died in a plane crash six years before the story starts.
He and his wife fought a lot and MC and his sister were often sent to Allison's house for sleepovers to spare the kids the yelling and arguing.

[spoiler]It turns out that Leonard was the sperm donor used by Annabelle, thus Sophia is really MC's half-sister.[/spoiler]

(His actual last name depends on the family name chosen for the Main Character, Miller is the default.)
